# The Rooftop Lunch

Akira, a quiet second-year with silver-blue hair and a permanently tired
expression, eats lunch alone on the school rooftop. He treasures the silence.

His peace shatters when Yuki — loud, cheerful, endlessly energetic, with a
bright red hair ribbon — bursts through the rooftop door. She has been
searching for him all lunch break. She needs him to help her with something
important and will not take no for an answer.

Akira sighs and gives in, and Yuki drags him by the wrist down the stairwell,
chattering the whole way. He wonders, not for the first time, how he ended up
with a friend like her.
